Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 8152 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Hardev Singh,Ramesh Chandra Agrahari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.

1. Heard Sri Ramesh Chandra Agrahari, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pankaj Kumar,
learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
2.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 103 of 2022, under Sections 407, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of IPC, Police Station Mugalsarai, District Chandauli, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant has claimed parity with the co-accused Suryakant Kumar Singh, who has already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. No.6768 of 2023 vide order dated 26.6.2023.

Since the case of the applicant is at par with the co-accused who has already been granted Basuki Nath Hazari vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167426182/
1 anticipatory bail, the applicant is also entitled for the same on the ground of parity.

entities.text: Basuki Nath Hazari vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel has also stated that the applicant has no criminal history.
4. The prayer for anticipatory bail has been vehemently opposed by learned AGA.
However, the aforesaid factual aspects of the parity to the co-accused and also the fact of no criminal history assigned to the applicant, have not been disputed by him.
5. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.
6. Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the anticipatory bail of the applicant.

9. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
